description: Initial three-task autonomous-development smoke test. Tasks are deliberately low-risk and use only the Python standard library.

tasks.title: Create an evidence-based repository baseline
tasks.description: Inspect the current repository and create a concise factual baseline document. Do not invent commands or features. Record only entry points, build/test commands, modules, and gaps that are evidenced by files in the repository.
requirements: Create docs/repository_baseline.md.
Use the exact top-level heading '# Ego Link Repository Baseline'.
Include the exact section headings '## Current Structure', '## Verified Commands', '## P0 Boundary', and '## Risks and Gaps'.
Describe the actual repository as found; distinguish verified facts from unknowns.
Do not modify source code or configuration.

tasks.title: Add a repository layout contract test
tasks.description: Add a standalone Python standard-library unittest that protects the repository's current top-level layout. The test should be readable, deterministic, and runnable directly without installing dependencies.
requirements: Create quality_tests/test_repository_contract.py using only the Python standard library.
The test must determine the repository root from the test file location rather than the current working directory.
Check that docs, firmware, pc_simulator, quality_tests, and scripts exist as directories.
Check that README.md exists as a file.
Provide clear assertion messages.
The file must run successfully with 'python quality_tests/test_repository_contract.py'.

tasks.title: Add a tested Ego Link project doctor CLI
tasks.description: Create a small local diagnostic CLI for the Ego Link repository. It must report structural/tool checks in human-readable or JSON form and remain fully testable with temporary directories.
requirements: Create scripts/egolink_doctor.py using only the Python standard library.
Support '--root PATH' and '--json'.
Return a JSON object containing at least: ok, root, checks, and summary.
Each check must contain name, ok, and detail.
Check the five required top-level directories, README.md, whether the root is inside a Git work tree, and availability of Python, Git, and Codex commands.
Do not require a clean Git worktree: the doctor is executed before the supervisor commits the current task.
Exit with code 0 when all required checks pass and nonzero when a required check fails.
Keep check logic in importable functions so it can be tested without subprocess recursion.
Create quality_tests/test_egolink_doctor.py with temporary-directory tests for both passing and failing structures.
Do not install packages or change project configuration.
tasks.commit_message: feat(AUTO-003): add Ego Link project doctor
